Embedded, IoT & Edge AI

Connect physical devices to cloud intelligence — firmware, IoT gateways, sensor networks, and edge AI.

We develop the full stack from bare-metal firmware to cloud dashboards — sensors, gateways, MQTT brokers, time-series databases, and real-time monitoring systems.

Includes: Embedded firmware development (C/C++, MicroPython), IoT gateway and protocol integration (MQTT, Modbus, LoRa), Cloud-connected sensor dashboards, Edge AI and on-device inference, Device provisioning and OTA updates, Time-series data storage and visualization.

Technologies: C/C++, Python, MQTT, InfluxDB, ESP32/STM32, AWS IoT.

Use cases: Sensor monitoring, Device firmware, Edge inference, IoT dashboards.

What does Embedded, IoT & Edge AI include? Connect physical devices to cloud intelligence — firmware, IoT gateways, sensor networks, and edge AI.

How does AICORE scope this kind of project? We start with discovery, define the users and data flows, map integrations, identify delivery risks, and then propose a phased build plan with clear milestones.

Can this integrate with our existing systems? Yes. AICORE designs solutions around existing tools, APIs, databases, devices, and operational workflows wherever possible.
